instruction: Find Team Fortress 2 and add all available downloadable content items to cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Team Fortress 2 in Steam store and adding all DLC items to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires adding 'all available downloadable content items' but evaluator only checks for ONE item ('Team Fortress 2 Soundtrack')

Semantic mismatch: 'Team Fortress 2 Soundtrack' is a standalone soundtrack product, not a downloadable content (DLC) item for the game. DLC typically refers to in-game content like maps, weapons, characters, not separate soundtrack albums
Cannot verify completeness: Evaluator has no mechanism to determine what 'all available' DLC items are or verify that ALL items were added - it only checks if one specific item exists in cart

Fragile verification logic: Simple substring matching ('item not in content') may produce false positives if the string appears elsewhere in HTML (e.g., recommendations, related items) and cannot handle variations in item naming
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected items list to include ALL actual DLC items available for Team Fortress 2 (research what DLC actually exists for TF2 - note that TF2 is free-to-play and may not have traditional DLC)
If the task is about the soundtrack specifically, update the instruction to say 'add Team Fortress 2 Soundtrack to cart' instead of 'all available downloadable content items'
Consider using a more robust cart verification method that can parse the actual cart items list from the Steam cart page HTML structure, rather than simple substring matching
Add metadata documenting what the 'all available DLC items' actually are, so the evaluator can verify completeness
